name: Sophie Nguyen
psychographics: Relaxed about spending if it saves time; often forgets to cancel trial subscriptions but loves a good discount.
current_solutions: Uses the Woolworths Rewards app; relies heavily on 'Yellow Sticker' discounts at the end of the day for meat and produce.
frustration: Last Monday at 7:45pm, she arrived at her local Woolworths to find the yellow sticker aisle completely empty; she had to buy pre-packaged salads at double the price because she was starving.
decision_style: Impulse-buy driven by discounts; often regrets purchases after checking her banking app on Sunday.
voice: Casual and slang-heavy; frequently uses 'totes' and 'obvs' when talking about deals.
